notes: The scribe's name is written 'ḍillirāma śarmaṇadaḥ'. This is probably a corruption of 'ḍillirāmaśarmaṇedaṃ' (= Dillīrāmaśarmaṇā idam). The name is normalized to Dillīrāma, which is also the catalogue's reading. The date is given only in the Śaka era: ŚS 1756 + 78 = 1834 CE. Vaiśākha falls in April–May 1834. The weekday (Monday) has not been verified.
